metadata.method: Composio Notion title search and complete parent enumeration; full page markdown; all 18 attached JSON archives; attachment hashes/count checks; corpus-wide keyword screening across name/tagline/summary/tags followed by manual candidate selection and function mapping; targeted official-site checks; repository documentation and selected public contract inspection.
limits: Archive coverage is 2026-10-02 through 2026-10-19, not current-day Product Hunt coverage.
15,964 records were mechanically screened; selected candidates and mappings were read and synthesized. This is not a manual deep read of every product.
Product descriptions, prices and performance claims remain archival unless a specific live-check note says otherwise. Official marketing claims are not independently benchmarked.
Repository baseline is documentation and selected public contract inspection at the local checkout, not a comprehensive implementation-gap audit or release/deployment verification.
Enhancements and priorities are proposals, not confirmed missing features or a delivery commitment.
One post URL, ChickyTutor, occurs on two archive days. Product page URLs can repeat across distinct launches.

products.name: 3AM Super Intelligence
products.archived_tagline: Production incidents: investigated, proven, fixed
products.archived_summary: 3AM is an AI on-call engineer for production systems that cannot be rewritten, aimed at regulated enterprises such as banks. It runs on-prem inside the customer network with no inbound ports, correlates alerts, logs, metrics, deploys and CMDB data to prove a root cause against live systems, rehearses a fix and applies it after one human approval in Slack, keeping a tamper-evident audit trail. It integrates with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, PagerDuty, Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Kubernetes and major databases; a 90-day free trial on up to 10 installs is offered alongside demos.
archived_features: Every action human-approved, one tap in Slack
Integrations: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, PagerDuty, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle

products.name: Attestlane
products.archived_tagline: SOC 2 readiness, clear next steps for lean SaaS teams
products.archived_summary: Attestlane is SOC 2 readiness software for small SaaS teams facing their first enterprise security request. It starts with a free ~10-minute readiness assessment and risk-ranked gap report, then guides teams through AI-assisted policy drafts that management must approve (about 20 policies) and evidence collection with provenance (about 39 items), producing a structured package for an independent CPA auditor. It states clearly that it is not an auditor and does not guarantee certification.
archived_features: Free readiness assessment and gap report
Policy drafts with management approval workflow
Evidence tracking with source, owner and status

products.name: BugHarbor
products.archived_tagline: Turn user feedback into pull requests you can review
products.archived_summary: BugHarbor brings user feedback and JavaScript errors into one inbox and uses its Agent to investigate reported issues in your repository and open pull requests for review, with hand-off to Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code. Its site confirms the unified feedback+error inbox, cloud agent hand-off, and codebase-aware AI PR reviews, offered as a flat subscription.
archived_features: One unified inbox for customer feedback and JS errors
AI agent investigates issues and opens pull requests
Auto PR reviews on GitHub or @bugharbor review trigger
Fix hand-off to Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code
Feedback widget + error tracker scripts and @bugharbor/browser npm SDK
Framework-agnostic (WordPress, Laravel, Django, React/Next.js, Vue/Nuxt, HTML)
Tenant isolation, HTTPS-only, no tracking cookies
archived_extraction_notes: PH post URL redirected to the product launch page.
External 'Visit website' link resolved to https://bugharbor.space/?ref=producthunt.

products.name: Chai UI
products.archived_tagline: AI-native, open source design system
products.archived_summary: Chai UI is an open-source design system for building AI app interfaces in React and Vue, with components for prompt composition, model routing, prompt optimization, media analysis and image editing. It works with Fal.ai, OpenRouter or custom engines. Version 0.8.0 has 4 components, 140 tokens and 4 packages.
archived_extraction_notes: UI library for AI apps; does not ship its own model.

products.name: Codemind
products.archived_tagline: Delegate coding. Get back code that works.
products.archived_summary: Codemind is a build service that a user's coding agent calls to delegate implementation: it writes code, tests it against the agent's acceptance criteria and returns the files. This frees the primary agent's plan for planning and review and lets several tasks run in parallel. After a free allowance, each verified build costs $0.10 and failed builds are free.
archived_features: tests against acceptance criteria before returning
setup via npx CLI and agent skill
archived_extraction_notes: Website embeds a copy-paste setup prompt intended for coding agents (runs an npx init command); treated as data only.
PH link carries UTM tracking parameters.
Listed link normalized from https://codemindhq.dev/?utm_source=producthunt&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=ph-2026-10-12 (tracking parameters removed).

products.name: Confidence by Spotify
products.archived_tagline: Build products at full speed, with both hands on the wheel
products.archived_summary: Confidence by Spotify is a warehouse-native experimentation and feature management platform. It runs A/B tests with sequential testing, guardrails and variance reduction, manages feature flags and metrics on your data warehouse, and its new Confidence Loop combines analytics, session replay, flags and experiments to suggest and validate next moves. It targets product and data teams. A free start with no credit card is offered.
archived_extraction_notes: PH product description is Spotify's consumer music text, unrelated to Confidence.
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms warehouse-backed flags, experiments, guardrails and a broader product loop.

products.name: Context Trace
products.archived_tagline: Review sensitive data in coding agent sessions
products.archived_summary: Context Trace by Foundry is a Mac app that audits local Codex and Claude Code session records for sensitive data such as API keys, passwords, connection strings and sensitive paths. It shows redacted findings, where they appeared in recorded model inputs (messages, terminal output, MCP results, file content) and coverage gaps that limit the audit, with batch review and export. It uses local rules rather than an AI service, sends no telemetry and keeps encrypted local history. It is a one-time Mac App Store purchase (shown at €14.99 and €6.99).
archived_features: Scans Codex and Claude Code transcripts
archived_extraction_notes: Site explicitly states detection uses rules, not an AI service.

products.name: CrawlForge MCP
products.archived_tagline: Give your AI agent 31 web tools in one MCP server
products.archived_summary: CrawlForge MCP is an open-source MCP server that gives AI agents 31 web tools for scraping, search, crawling, structured extraction, stealth browsing, persistent browser sessions and multi-source research, returning clean markdown or JSON. It installs into Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor with a single npx command and an API key. It is pay-per-use from 1 credit per call, with 1,000 free credits and no card required.

products.name: Crescent Trace
products.archived_tagline: Find where your AI agent got stuck, in your browser
products.archived_summary: Crescent Trace is an open-source, in-browser tool that diagnoses failed AI agent traces. Paste a JSON/JSONL trace from OpenTelemetry (OpenInference/gen_ai), LangChain/LangGraph or OpenAI messages and its deterministic rules flag repeats, ping-pong loops, retry storms and unreturned tool calls, pinpoint the failing step and estimate wasted tokens. An optional 'Ask the dragon' feature sends flagged steps to Claude for a root-cause explanation; the core runs locally for free.
archived_features: Supports Phoenix, Langfuse, smolagents, LangGraph, OpenAI traces

products.name: Diggama
products.archived_tagline: Define your content once. Deliver it to your everywhere
products.archived_summary: Diggama is a headless CMS repositioned for AI-coded websites: AI tools like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor build the frontend while Diggama provides the backend. It offers blueprints with field types and validation, scheduling, multilingual publishing, a REST API, webhooks, roles and an MCP server.

products.name: DogeBot
products.archived_tagline: Build Powerful Discord & WhatsApp Bots Without Writing Code
products.archived_summary: DogeBot is a no-code platform for building Discord and WhatsApp bots by placing and connecting blocks on a canvas, with bots hosted around the clock. Discord bots get slash and context commands, 100+ events, rich messages, and ready modules (tickets, moderation, leveling, shops); WhatsApp bots run on Meta's official Cloud API with keyword/button flows and per-contact memory. Built-in per-user/server data storage is included; there's a free plan with no card and a 7-day money-back guarantee on paid plans.
archived_extraction_notes: Site banner notes built-in modules page is being redesigned due to issues

products.name: EditUI
products.archived_tagline: Point at your UI. Tell your coding agent what to change.
products.archived_summary: EditUI is a free, open-source Chrome extension for reviewing a running app: click any element, leave an instruction, collect many edits and send them as one prompt to Claude Code, Cursor or another coding agent. No repo setup, signup or backend is needed. It targets developers iterating on UI with coding agents.

products.name: Energy Icons
products.archived_tagline: A free, open-source icon library for everyone
products.archived_summary: Energy Icons is a free open-source icon library with deep coverage of energy, climate and infrastructure, currently 1,461 icons across categories like generation, grid & storage, heat & buildings and transport. It offers regular and bold weights, two optical masters, a Figma plugin and icon requests, aiming for 100,000 icons.

products.name: ExcaliClaw
products.archived_tagline: Hand-drawn diagrams your AI agent can draw with you
products.archived_summary: ExcaliClaw is a collaborative workspace for hand-drawn style diagrams with persistent storage, collections, instant search, link/name sharing and real-time co-drawing. Its MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or VS Code agents create and edit diagrams. The free plan includes 200 drawings and unlimited MCP use without a card; paid plans start at EUR 9/month.
archived_features: MCP tools for AI agents to draw
version history, trash and backup export
archived_extraction_notes: Website text captured was minimal (a single descriptive paragraph).
Listed link normalized from https://excaliclaw.com (tracking parameters removed).

products.name: Exostor
products.archived_tagline: Cloud storage and secure file sharing for creators
products.archived_summary: Exostor is cloud storage for creators that shares files and folders through revocable links gated by Patreon membership tiers, verifying entitlements on each access with unlimited downloads.

products.name: FastRouter.ai
products.archived_tagline: Route requests to the right LLM for cost, latency & quality
products.archived_summary: FastRouter is a unified AI gateway that routes requests across 200+ LLMs through one OpenAI-compatible API, optimizing for cost, latency and quality. It offers automatic failover, observability and governance, plus an Insights feature that analyzes routed traffic to recommend savings. Targeted at developers and enterprise AI teams.
archived_features: Insights report with ranked cost-saving changes

products.name: Figma Specs
products.archived_tagline: A container for your context that lives on the Figma canvas
products.archived_summary: Figma Specs (beta) is a collaborative Markdown document inside Figma that can stand alone or sit beside designs on the canvas. It embeds Figma frames and FigJam diagrams, supports comment-based discussion with teammates and agents, and passes the full context to coding agents through Figma's MCP server. It has free options as part of Figma.
archived_features: embed Figma frames and FigJam diagrams
context exported to coding agents via MCP

products.name: FutureMail
products.archived_tagline: Email on your domain, built for people and their AI agents
products.archived_summary: FutureMail is email hosting for a domain you own, with unlimited addresses, catch-all and plus-addressing, and a keyboard-first inbox with threading and search. It gives AI agents their own scoped inboxes that can send, read, search and wait for verification codes via a REST API, CLI or remote MCP server, and its API is Resend-compatible. Production features include signed webhooks, templates, scheduled/batch sends and open/click tracking. It costs $20/month on a single plan with no per-seat fees.
archived_features: unlimited addresses with catch-all and plus-addressing
REST API, CLI and remote MCP server
archived_extraction_notes: Provides email infrastructure for agents rather than shipping AI itself.
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms scoped agent inboxes, REST/CLI/MCP, domain setup and an outbound-compatible interface.

products.name: GBrain Tools
products.archived_tagline: A password manager for AI
products.archived_summary: GBrain Tools is a 'password manager for AI': you connect accounts like Gmail, GitHub, Stripe and Notion once, and ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or a terminal can use them without ever seeing the credentials. Each AI gets per-app permission levels, end dates, daily limits and a kill switch, and every call is logged in one record. It costs $19 a month.
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms credential-held calls, per-app permission levels, expiry and daily limits.

products.name: GitSync
products.archived_tagline: Sync branches between GitHub repos, right from Chrome
products.archived_summary: GitSync is a Chrome extension that copies/syncs a branch from one GitHub repo to another you can write to, with full commit history or just the latest snapshot, into an existing or new branch. It runs entirely in the browser with no GitSync server, using GitHub's OAuth device flow and git-over-HTTPS.
archived_features: Copy/sync a branch between GitHub repos from a Chrome side panel
Latest commit only or full history
Push to existing branch, force push, or open a pull request
Create a new target branch; sync an entire repo (up to 100 branches)
Preview before anything is written; cancellable
Sign-in via GitHub OAuth device flow; token kept on device up to 7 days

products.name: HiddenContent.ai
products.archived_tagline: Find the text in a document your AI reads and you can't see
products.archived_summary: HiddenContent.ai is an API and MCP server that scans Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint files and web pages for text hidden from people but readable by LLMs, such as white or tiny text, off-page text and invisible characters. It returns findings with location and technique, a verdict, flags on hidden instructions, clean text and a signed certificate.

products.name: Hindsight 1.0 + Memlake
products.archived_tagline: Open source memory for AI agents to learn from experience
products.archived_summary: Hindsight by Vectorize is open-source (MIT) memory for AI agents that stores per-user context and turns failures and corrections into experiences so agents improve over time. Version 1.0 marks a stable API, and Memlake is a new Rust storage engine keeping agent memory in object storage (claimed 100M memories under 100 ms p99). It is model-agnostic. Self-host free, Hindsight Cloud with free credits, or Enterprise in your own cloud.
archived_features: learns from tool failures and corrections
archived_extraction_notes: Benchmark leadership claims are vendor-reported.

products.name: Holdy
products.archived_tagline: AI agent that turns more trials into paying customers
products.archived_summary: Holdy is an AI agent for B2B SaaS product teams that analyzes how accounts use the product to find where activation and trial conversion stall. It delivers fixes as GitHub pull requests, in-app tips via its SDK, or messages, ready for human approval, then measures each change against a held-out control group to attribute behavior and MRR impact. Free options; no credit card required and it installs in about two minutes.
archived_features: Fixes shipped as GitHub PRs or in-app tips
archived_extraction_notes: Site shows Portuguese loading text, suggesting a Brazilian team

products.name: Inferock
products.archived_tagline: Serverless inference, with credits back for failed calls.
products.archived_summary: Inferock offers LLM inference with accountability: Inferock Watch observes calls made with your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini keys, Inferock Serve provides pay-per-token serverless inference, and Inferock Dedicated offers reserved capacity. It records per-call usage, failures and cost, and gives credits back for eligible failed calls. An open-source local proxy (inferock-bench) generates independent receipts of what you were billed. Signup credits are free; Watch is free on your own provider accounts.
archived_features: credits back on eligible failed calls
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms provider-account observation, per-call usage/cost evidence and credits for eligible failures. Confidential-route language is conditional; ordinary Watch is excluded.

products.name: Kai Resolve by Gleap
products.archived_tagline: Support that does the digging for you.
products.archived_summary: Kai Resolve is Gleap's second-level AI support agent for tickets that docs-based bots cannot answer. It investigates using the customer's screen recording, logs, account data and read-only access to your code, then either answers the customer or escalates with a diagnosis; confirmed bugs become coding tasks the team reviews. It costs about $0.49 per investigation on average, with a 7-day free trial.
archived_features: reads session recordings, logs and account data
confirmed bugs become reviewable coding tasks
archived_extraction_notes: Part of Gleap's Kai agent suite (Kai Support, Kai Code, Kai PM).
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms diagnosis using recordings, logs and read-only code before a coding-task handoff.

products.name: Kerno 1.0
products.archived_tagline: The AI Runtime Backend QA Engineer
products.archived_summary: Kerno is an AI backend QA engineer that maps a codebase, learns how the app works, and writes and runs tests against the running app and real dependencies. Version 1.0 extends coverage to full user flows, live security checks, background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless. Bugs are caught locally inside a coding agent's session before a PR is opened and re-checked on every PR in CI. A free tier is available, plus enterprise plans.
archived_features: Tests against the live local stack
E2E, API, contract, security, MCP and async testing
Runs inside Claude Code/Cursor agent loop

products.name: Kinhin
products.archived_tagline: Turn your Mac into an autoscaling CI runner pool
products.archived_summary: Kinhin turns a Mac into an autoscaling pool of ephemeral CI runners: macOS jobs run in Tart VMs and Linux jobs in apple/container microVMs, Docker or Tart Linux VMs, each deleted after the job. It serves GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Gitea and Forgejo Actions from one pool, routes jobs by repo, workflow or label, and reserves host CPU, memory and disk headroom. It runs as a menu bar app or headless daemon, is free and open source, and is in beta (v0.0.1-beta-1).
archived_features: GitHub, GitLab CE, Gitea, Forgejo support
archived_extraction_notes: Buildkite, Azure Pipelines and Bitbucket support planned.
Listed link normalized from https://kinhin.dev (tracking parameters removed).

products.name: kinora
products.archived_tagline: A dashboard for Playwright reports, across projects and time
products.archived_summary: kinora is an open-source dashboard for Playwright test reports across projects and over time. CI runs are pushed to it to track pass rates and durations, surface flaky tests and regressions, compare runs and open full traces inline. Self-host for free or use the hosted cloud.
archived_features: Flaky and fail rate per test

products.name: KloudMate 2.0
products.archived_tagline: AI-powered Full-Stack Observability & Agentic SRE-Ops
products.archived_summary: KloudMate 2.0 is an observability platform unifying metrics, logs and traces with infrastructure, database, RUM, synthetic and serverless monitoring. Its AI modules (Assistant, Builder, Investigator, Docs) answer questions, build dashboards and alarms, and perform root cause analysis. It started as an AWS serverless monitoring tool.

products.name: Lancetta
products.archived_tagline: Know when to push your coding agents, and when to ease off
products.archived_summary: Lancetta is a free native macOS menu-bar app that reads Claude Code and Codex quota usage and advises whether to push on, slow down, or switch agents, e.g. warning when a window will reset unused or when an agent will hit its limit. It also scans what agents load at startup, kills leftover background processes, and shows all sessions on one wall with those waiting on you first. Reading quota spends no tokens; it requires macOS 15+ and is signed and notarized.

products.name: Lazy AWS
products.archived_tagline: A keyboard-driven home for your AWS resources
products.archived_summary: Lazy AWS is an open-source keyboard-driven terminal UI for browsing and inspecting AWS resources across services, showing JSON details and related resources. Actions are previewed as the exact AWS CLI command with account and target, and only run after confirmation. It installs via curl or Homebrew on macOS and Linux (no Windows), needs AWS CLI v2, and has a demo mode with sample data.
archived_features: confirmed AWS CLI actions with command preview
account and region always in view

products.name: Levelrail
products.archived_tagline: Self-hosted deployment platform: push to git and deploy
products.archived_summary: Levelrail is an open-source, self-hosted deployment platform shipped as a single Go binary without Kubernetes. Pushing to git produces a running app with TLS, logs, metrics and rollback, along with readiness-gated zero-downtime cutover, preview environments per pull request, multi-node placement with a mesh, a CLI and an HTTP control-plane API. The site documents architecture, security and a feature-maturity status page.
archived_extraction_notes: Source: github.com/glincker/levelrail.
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms a self-hosted deployment control plane. It explicitly says TLS is self-signed until Let’s Encrypt is enabled, a qualification missing from the shorter archive summary.

products.name: LocaPilot
products.archived_tagline: Generate automation locators in one click
products.archived_summary: LocaPilot is a Chrome extension in beta for Selenium and Playwright testers that generates locator candidates (ID, CSS, XPath, data-testid, name, ARIA) for a clicked element. It validates each against the DOM, scores quality and copies Selenium Java or Playwright Java code.

products.name: loginos
products.archived_tagline: One-tap sign-in and passkeys for every domain you run
products.archived_summary: loginos is a hosted sign-in service giving every domain a platform runs one shared user pool, so users sign up once and are signed in across domains, including customers' own domains. Chrome and Edge show a native 'Continue as' prompt without a redirect, other browsers use a small popup, and passkeys with Face ID, fingerprint or security keys are supported. Roles and permissions travel in each token, existing users can link accounts without migration, and it uses standard OpenID Connect. It is free to start with no card.

products.name: Lookout (for Slack)
products.archived_tagline: Urgent Slack messages, handled instantly. Powered by Jev.
products.archived_summary: Lookout is a Slack app that watches chosen channels for time-sensitive messages described in plain words (e.g. customers blocked from logging in, specific errors, big signups) and takes a chosen action such as reacting, DMing the on-call, or creating a Linear issue. Message text is classified by Jev (TypeSafe) and cleared after processing; it does not train on messages. It is free during beta.
archived_features: actions: react, DM, create Linear issue

products.name: Markdoc
products.archived_tagline: A shared Markdown editor for people and their agents
products.archived_summary: Markdoc is a real-time collaborative Markdown editor with source and editable preview side by side. It supports comments, suggesting mode, version history and offline editing, lets users bring their own agent via MCP, and publishes to a gist or repository file. Free during preview; GitHub account required.
products.live_check_note: Official URL could not be read through the web tool; use archived evidence only. This does not establish that the product is unavailable.

products.name: Maybloc
products.archived_tagline: new SOTA for speech-to-text for multi-speaker audio
products.archived_summary: Maybloc is speech-to-text infrastructure for multi-speaker audio, separating up to 25 speakers, keeping overlapping speech and timing each word, across 45 languages. It claims the lowest diarization error on several benchmarks versus Pyannote, Deepgram and AssemblyAI. Add-ons include subtitles, PII redaction, summaries, speaker names and translation, via a dashboard or REST API.

products.name: mcpgawk
products.archived_tagline: Catch MCP servers that change after you approved them
products.archived_summary: mcpgawk records a baseline of every MCP server your agents use, checks behaviour in a sandbox, and blocks calls to any tool whose description or capabilities changed after approval until you decide. It runs locally with nothing uploaded and works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf and Gemini CLI.
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms approved-tool baselines and holding calls when a tool changes.

products.name: Mintlify Desktop
products.archived_tagline: An AI-native app for writing documentation and knowledge
products.archived_summary: Mintlify is an AI-native documentation platform whose Desktop app writes and maintains documentation and knowledge; the site markets 'self-updating documentation' and an 'agent-native platform' where agents keep work moving 24/7. It serves 20,000+ companies including Microsoft, Amazon and Anthropic, with access control, integrations and enterprise-grade reliability.
archived_features: Connect with existing systems and stack
archived_extraction_notes: PH 'Visit website' link was https://mintlify.com/; final resolved URL is https://www.mintlify.com/.
PH post covers the Desktop app; site content describes the broader Mintlify platform.
products.evidence_quality_limit: Launch is Desktop-specific, while archived official homepage describes the broader platform.

products.name: MuscleMemory
products.archived_tagline: Give AI agents memory of what actually worked
products.archived_summary: MuscleMemory is an open-source procedural memory layer for AI agents that turns successful, test-verified agent runs into reusable skills and records failed attempts as warnings, so the next agent starts with a short verified note. Skills require repeated passing tests and human approval before reuse. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and MCP-compatible agents via MCP, REST and SDKs, installs with pipx and can run locally with Docker and PostgreSQL. Reported benchmarks claim about 30% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer input tokens at the same success rate, with a whitepaper and research paper published.
archived_features: Cross-agent skill sharing (Codex-learned skills used by Claude Code)
archived_extraction_notes: Benchmarks are small (18 Codex sessions, 8 Claude Code sessions, a small SWE-bench run) per the site

products.name: NestJS Observe
products.archived_tagline: Zero-config observability built for NestJS
products.archived_summary: NestJS Observe is an observability service for NestJS apps built by the framework's creator. After adding the SDK and a key, every request appears as a trace of the app's controllers, providers and queries, with auto-correlated logs, grouped errors with source context, job and runtime metrics, SLOs and alerts for silent apps or stuck crons. It removes the need to hand-wire OpenTelemetry. It is free up to 300k events a month, with paid plans.

products.name: NitroStack
products.archived_tagline: Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place
products.archived_summary: NitroStack is a platform for building, testing and deploying Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and MCP apps. It combines open-source TypeScript and Python SDKs, an MCP CLI, a desktop studio (NitroStudio) for visual testing and debugging, a workflow tool for agent orchestration, and NitroCloud managed hosting, with connectors to ChatGPT, Claude and other AI clients. It targets developers shipping production MCP servers; sign-up includes free tokens and deployment, with paid pricing listed.
archived_features: NitroStudio desktop app for visual MCP testing/debugging
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms SDK, desktop studio and managed MCP hosting; no runtime was exercised.

products.name: Notarus
products.archived_tagline: Website feedback with the evidence attached
products.archived_summary: Notarus is a website feedback and bug reporting tool whose widget captures annotated screenshots, console and network logs, environment details, session replay and screen recordings with each report. Reports land on a board pipeline (Received, WIP, QA, Done) and sync two-way with Jira, Linear, GitHub, Asana, Trello, ClickUp or monday.com. It also offers a reporter portal, client portal, surveys (NPS, CSAT) and a Pro review mode for filing tickets on the live page. Most features are on the free plan.
archived_features: Session replay of minutes before report
archived_extraction_notes: PH topics include AI but no concrete AI feature was evident

products.name: Octri.dev
products.archived_tagline: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring
products.archived_summary: Octri takes an OpenAPI spec and generates a customizable docs site, SDKs in ten languages and an MCP server, keeping them current via GitHub sync. Each SDK includes an opt-in error reporter that sends stack traces tagged to the SDK release back to the API owner. A free spec audit score is available without signup.
products.live_check_note: Official site confirms a shared OpenAPI source for docs, SDKs, MCP and diagnostics.

products.name: OpenFlowKit 2
products.archived_tagline: Free, open-source diagrams you and your agent edit together
products.archived_summary: OpenFlowKit 2 is a free, MIT-licensed, local-first diagram canvas in the browser with no account. Diagrams can be drawn, written as code or pasted from Mermaid, D2 or Structurizr, generated by any of 10 AI providers or a local model, edited live by Claude Code over MCP (29 tools), or generated from a GitHub repo with arrows citing file and line. A CLI checks diagram drift in CI.
archived_features: 29 MCP tools for live agent editing

products.name: opensend.cc
products.archived_tagline: The open source email platform that runs on your server
products.archived_summary: opensend.cc is an Apache-2.0 open-source email platform you self-host, sending through your own AWS SES account. It offers a Resend-compatible REST API and SDK, SMTP, React templates, broadcasts, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs, deployed with Docker Compose. There is no per-email fee beyond AWS costs; a cloud version has a waitlist.

products.name: Pancake
products.archived_tagline: The Vercel for GTM
products.archived_summary: Pancake is a go-to-market platform that exposes a 'GTM brain', email sending infrastructure and 40+ data and enrichment providers to AI agents such as Claude or Codex through a single MCP connection. Users describe a go-to-market idea to their agent and Pancake supplies the data and tools to execute it. The site targets agencies, consultants, startups and solo founders across many industries. It has a free tier ('Start free') and a pricing page.

products.name: Parrot
products.archived_tagline: Smart Meeting Assistant for Mac that helps during the call
products.archived_summary: Parrot is a free, open-source Mac meeting recorder that captures system audio and microphone without a bot joining the call, transcribing and detecting speakers on device. During calls it surfaces answers from the user's own documents (pricing sheets, FAQs) with the source file, and afterwards produces a report of promises made and missed questions plus chat across all meetings. products.name: Phelix

products.archived_summary: Phelix is a single-binary, open-source deployment tool for Go and Rust apps on the user's own Linux or macOS servers. It builds versioned binaries with encrypted environment snapshots and deploys with health-check-gated traffic switching via blue-green, rolling or canary strategies, with or without Docker, plus instant rollback. A built-in MCP server lets coding agents like Claude Code and Codex inspect services and prepare deployments through an approval-gated pipeline, and an optional dashboard adds multi-server monitoring.

products.name: PigeonAtlas

It provides delivery tracking, webhooks and a dashboard, with 1,000 free messages per month.
